app_identity.name: SurakshaCFO
app_identity.tagline: India's First AI Family CFO & Intelligent Insurance Protection Engine
app_identity.context: India / INR Financial Ecosystem (Term Insurance, Health Floater, 6x Emergency Fund, Mutual Fund Surplus Allocation)
app_identity.target_audience: Indian working professionals, MNC employees, business owners, and freelancers planning long-term security for their families.

design_archetype.name: Swiss-Warm Executive & Family Trust Minimalist
design_archetype.description: Combines the structured precision of modern Swiss financial dashboards with warm, inviting family-centric tones. Clean, crisp 1px borders, high-density metric callouts, and tabular numeric typography.
design_archetype.theme_strategy: Dual-mode support with warm off-white canvas for light mode (#F9F8F5) and deep obsidian graphite (#0F1115) for dark mode. High contrast for instant scanability.

scale.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wider uppercase
scale.currency_large: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums

header_navigation.description: Sticky blurred header with brand logo, stage progress tracker, quick action buttons, and INR currency badge.

profile_wizard_form.description: Multi-step interactive form collecting family demographic details, income structure, liabilities, and current coverage.

cfo_analytics_dashboard.description: Comprehensive post-wizard dashboard displaying financial protection score, coverage gap analysis, emergency fund runway, and surplus flow.
sections: Protection Score Ring & Risk Meter (0-100 score based on coverage vs liabilities)
Term Insurance Needs Analysis Card (Formula: [15x Annual Income + Total Loans - Existing Cover])
Health Insurance Floater Recommender Card (Formula: Base 10L-25L + Top-up based on Family size & City Tier)
6-Month Emergency Fund Shield Card (Goal vs Current savings gap)
Annual Financial Cashflow Waterfall (Income - Expenses - EMIs - Insurance Premiums = Investable Surplus)
Transparent Rule Calculation Drawer & Disclaimer Modal

insurance_hub_and_comparison.description: Interactive showcase of recommended Indian Term & Health Insurance plans with side-by-side comparison matrix.
features: Filter by Term vs Health Insurance
Custom annual premium estimates computed for user's age
Riders selector (Critical Illness, Accidental Disability, Waiver of Premium)
Plan Comparison Drawer for detailed side-by-side analysis

rag_ai_cfo_chatbot.description: Context-aware AI Advisor floating widget and full tab that reads the user's saved family profile to answer complex insurance queries.
capabilities: Pre-built prompt chips ('Why do I need ₹1.5 Cr Term plan?', 'HDFC Ergo vs Star Health comparison', 'Should I take critical illness rider?')
Real-time rule explanation citing Indian tax benefits (Section 80D, 80C)
Interactive scenario simulator ('What if my salary increases by 20%?')

allocation_logic: Priority 1: Complete 6-Month Emergency Fund gap in liquid/overnight funds.
Priority 2: Pay Term + Health Insurance premiums.
Priority 3: Split remaining surplus into Nifty 50 Index Funds (50%), Flexi-Cap Funds (30%), and Mid-Cap Growth (20%).

family_trust_images.description: Happy Indian family outdoors, representing protection and peace of mind
Smiling Indian father with children representing caring protection
Warm family bonding scene for onboarding hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: Write code using React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components matching existing frontend architecture.
Implement the multi-step profile wizard with clear progress indicators, validation, and local storage persistence so users don't lose data on refresh.

Calculate rule-based financial protection metrics accurately using Indian standard formulas (Term cover = 10-15x income + liabilities - existing cover; Health cover = 10L-25L floater + super topup; Emergency fund = 6x monthly expenses).
Display prominent disclaimers clearly marking the estimates as rule-based recommendations for educational purposes.
Ensure the dashboard gracefully handles empty/unsubmitted profiles by providing a pre-loaded sample benchmark profile toggle ('View Sample Family Profile').
Build a rich, context-aware RAG Chatbot UI with preset quick questions, message history, plan comparison generator, and typing indicator.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive buttons, inputs, cards, and navigation links as outlined in the testing section.
